title: National Park Visits Fell To 323 Million
hook: National park visits fell to 323 million.
closing: Even a modest decline reaches gateway businesses, staffing, and the visitor experience.
question: Which national park comes first?

segments.say: National park visits reached 331.9 million. The system set a new attendance record.
National park visits fell to 323 million. A shutdown year immediately reversed the record.
Blue Ridge Parkway drew 16.5 million visits. Famous destinations kept attracting crowds despite the broader decline.
